title: Q-FAS-decision-spinoff-launch: action class decision:spinoff-launch keeps disturbing other essential variables
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** freeadapt pass: action class `decision:spinoff-launch` kept 0.0 of its last 6 measured actions efficient (floor 0.5); essential variables disturbed while they were open: claims_drift, deploy_health, stalled_clocks, value
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation freeadapt --probe decision:spinoff-launch
**Prediction:** action_classes_consistent_share >= 0.9 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** changing the floor, the window or the ledgers this reading comes from; the action's own target metric (scored elsewhere)
**Status:** closed

FREELY-ADAPTIVE-1 (Pérez López, IESE WP 5, 1974, chapter III): an ultrastable system discards action alternatives found to have decreasing efficiency. These actions reached their own targets or were reverted, but while they were open other needs of the system left their limits (the model was incomplete, not incorrect). Redesign the alternative so it guards the disturbed variables, or retire it from its loop.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation freeadapt --probe decision:spinoff-launch`

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T17:07:39Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
